name: Belbimbre (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle issuing from the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Belbimbre (a cross, a sheaf of wheat and a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Belbimbre; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
Belbimbre arms — cross, sheaf and castle
